testcase.name: Scenario 1: First deployment — write release and set live symlink
Scenario 2: Repeated idempotent deployment — no error, symlink correct
Scenario 3: Interrupted deployment — live symlink not updated on failure
Scenario 4: Resume after interrupted deployment — completes successfully
Scenario 5: Rollback — revert current symlink to v1
Scenario 6: DR STATE_CORRUPTION — verifiedHealthy true, rpoSeconds 0
Scenario 7: Cross-tenant auth denial — token for wrong audience rejected
Scenario 8: Forged language pack — artifactDigest mismatch causes invalid === false
Scenario 9: Revoked key — globalTrustRegistry.validateKeyStatus throws for key_recipe_v1
Scenario 10: Audit trail — atomic JSON write (tmp+rename) then read-back matches
